description: Color field: a swatch that opens a picker with hue, saturation and lightness, next to the editable hexadecimal value.

howToUse: Use it wherever people pick a color: theme editors, labels, charts. The value is always `#rrggbb`.
The swatch opens the picker with hue, saturation and lightness; the field next to it takes a typed hexadecimal and checks it.
Pass the theme colors in `presets` so the usual choices are one click away.
alternatives: A choice among a few named colors: Segmented or RadioGroup.
A token value that is not a color, such as a font or a radius: Input or Select.

keyboard.action: Moves from the swatch to the hexadecimal field.

props.name: label
props.description: Field name, shown above it and used as the accessible name of the swatch and the sliders.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with `#rrggbb` in lowercase whenever the color changes.

props.name: presets
props.description: Colors offered as one-click swatches in the picker (e.g. the theme palette).

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. The form receives the accepted color as `#rrggbb`, never an invalid draft.

props.name: appearance
props.description:
`field` (default): label, swatch and hexadecimal input. `swatch`: only a swatch that fills the
width, with the value below; `label` stays as the accessible name. For palettes in a row.
